speakers.name: Patricia Casaburi
speakers.role: Founder & Chief Executive Officer at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Founder and CEO of Global Citizen Solutions, graduate and post-graduate degrees in Commercial Law and Immigration from the University of Law in London, and a background in Media and Journalism, she combines legal expertise with strong communication skills. A dynamic leader, Patricia has built a transparent, collaborative, and client-focused company that empowers individuals and businesses to create value and secure their futures.

speakers.name: Bruno L’ecuyer
speakers.role: Co-founder at Investment Migration Council
speakers.bio: Bruno L’ecuyer FIMC is the Co-Founder & Chief Executive of the Investment Migration Council, a Swiss non-profit organisation. In his leadership role, Bruno actively contributes to global discussions on investment migration, regularly writing for international publications and speaking at conferences across Europe, North America, the Caribbean, the Middle East, and Asia. As a member of the Governing Board, Bruno serves as Secretary, chairs the Advisory Committee, and has held Consultative Status with the UN’s Economic & Social Council since 2019.

speakers.name: Mehdi Kadiri
speakers.role: President at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Mehdi Kadiri is President of Global Citizen Solutions (GCS), where he leads international expansion, institutional partnerships, and Government Advisory activities worldwide. With more than 20 years of experience spanning investment migration, wealth management, institutional banking, and international business, Mehdi has built and led businesses across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

speakers.name: H.E. Calvin St. Juste
speakers.role: Executive Chairman, St. Kitts and Nevis Citizenship Unit
speakers.bio: H.E. Calvin St. Juste is the Executive Chairman of the St. Kitts and Nevis Citizenship Unit and Honorary Special Envoy for Investment, Development, and International Business Relations. With over 25 years of international leadership experience in financial services, technology, and telecommunications, he has led the modernization of the country’s Citizenship Programme, focusing on compliance, biometrics, and digital transformation. A former Wall Street executive, he also serves on international advisory and governance boards, including the Asian Institute of Artificial Intelligence and Stevens Institute of Technology.

speakers.name: Alex Muscat
speakers.role: Member of Parliament, Malta
speakers.bio: Alex Muscat is an economist and Member of Parliament who has been closely involved in Malta’s citizenship policy for more than a decade. He served at the centre of government as Deputy Head of the Prime Minister’s Private Secretariat from 2013 to 2020, the period in which Malta launched its Individual Investor Programme and became one of the world’s best-known investment migration destinations. In 2020 he was appointed Parliamentary Secretary for Citizenship and Communities, with political responsibility for the programme. Today’s Citizenship by Merit regime builds on the legal framework he helped put in place, and he also contributed to the development of Malta’s current residence programmes. Having shaped Malta’s investment migration landscape from within government and followed its evolution to the current model, he is one of the leading voices on Malta’s citizenship policy and its future in Europe.

speakers.name: Pedro Lino
speakers.role: Chief Executive Officer at Optimize Investment Partners
speakers.bio: Pedro Lino is the CEO of Optimize Investment Partners, a leading independent asset manager in Portugal, and Co-Chief Investment Officer of the Golden Visa-eligible Portugal Golden Opportunities fund. He holds a degree in Economics from Nova SBE and has been passionate about financial markets since a young age. He frequently comments on economic and financial matters in both national and international media.

speakers.name: Francisca van Dijken
speakers.role: EMEA Head of Global Client Solutions at Citigroup Private Bank
speakers.bio: Francisca van Dijken leads Global Client Solutions for Europe, the UK, the Middle East and Africa at Citi Private Bank. Over more than 20 years in wealth management, she has worked as a private banker and held leadership roles at Citi, Merrill Lynch and Barclays Private Bank in Amsterdam and London. Throughout her career, she has advised sophisticated global families and international clients with complex cross-border structures.

speakers.name: Adalberto Pucca
speakers.role: Head of Global Client Advisory at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Adalberto Pucca is Head of Global Client Advisory at Global Citizen Solutions, where he leads the firm's global commercial strategy and its sales and business development activities.

speakers.name: Ayoub Rebroub
speakers.role: Legal Manager, Malta at Endevio Group
speakers.bio: Ayoub Rebroub is the newly appointed CEO of Endevio Group, a Malta-based advisory firm specialising in investment migration and global mobility solutions. With over eight years of industry experience, he has advised hundreds of international families and investors on Malta’s residency and citizenship programmes. He holds an MBA and is a Professional Member of the Investment Migration Council (IMC).

speakers.name: Dr. Nina Patrick, PhD
speakers.role: Longevity Researcher, Science Communicator & Entrepreneur
speakers.bio: Nina Patrick, PhD is a science communicator, entrepreneur, and longevity researcher. She holds a PhD in pharmaceutical sciences and has founded and exited a healthtech company, served as Head of Innovation at the Champalimaud Foundation, and is currently a Venture Partner at Maze Impact. She is the founder of Nina Patrick Inc., a longevity and health media company, and co-founder of Longevity Wednesdays, a 900+ member professional community in Lisbon.

speakers.name: Nathalie Willis-Davis
speakers.role: Founder & Managing Director at Tendoria
speakers.bio: Nathalie is the Founder and Managing Director of Tendoria, an educational consultancy specializing in school placement in Portugal and Spain, and global university admissions advisory. Together with her team of international education experts, Nathalie helps families make informed and confident educational decisions through highly personalized guidance.

speakers.name: Duarte Calheiros Menezes
speakers.role: Partner & Fund Manager at BlueCrow Capital
speakers.bio: Duarte Calheiros Menezes is a Partner and Fund Manager at BlueCrow Capital, which he joined in 2014. With over 15 years of experience in the financial sector, he specialises in asset structuring and management, with deep expertise in venture capital and private equity fund management.

speakers.name: Athanassios (Thanos) Tsoukalas
speakers.role: Legal Manager, Greece at AT Legal
speakers.bio: Thanos Tsoukalas is an attorney at law and founder of AT LEGAL, a boutique Greek law firm with offices in Athens and Corfu. He holds an LL.B. from the National & Kapodistrian University of Athens and an LL.M. with distinction in International & European Business Law from the Vrije Universiteit Brussel. His work is focused on investment migration, Golden Visas, real estate and cross-border advisory, serving global investors, high-net-worth individuals, foreign property buyers and businesses.

speakers.name: Nuno Serafim
speakers.role: Partner at C2 Capital
speakers.bio: Nuno Serafim is Partner and Head of Public Markets at C2 Capital Partners, where he oversees the firm's liquid investment strategies. With more than 25 years of experience across financial markets and asset management, he has held senior investment and leadership positions at some of Portugal's largest asset management firms, overseeing more than €5 billion in assets throughout his career.

speakers.name: Cintia Mano
speakers.role: Chief Investment Officer at European Longevity Hub
speakers.bio: Cintia Mano is Chief Investment Officer at the European Longevity Hub, where she focuses on investment and innovation in the longevity economy. She is an experienced angel investor and former CEO of an international angel investment community, with a track record supporting startups across multiple markets. She is also the author of Angel Investing Explained.

speakers.name: Joe Rice
speakers.role: Head of Citizenship Programs at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Joe Rice brings over two decades of expertise to his role as Head of Citizenship Programs at Global Citizen Solutions. Combining professional knowledge with personal experience, having obtained second citizenship himself and pursuing Portuguese residency, Joe has guided hundreds of clients through global mobility journeys. He is particularly renowned for his expertise in Caribbean citizenship programs, with established relationships across Antigua and Barbuda, Dominica, Grenada, St. Kitts and Nevis, and St. Lucia.

speakers.name: Bernardo Meyrelles
speakers.role: Country Head, Portugal at EFG
speakers.bio: Bernardo Meyrelles do Souto holds a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Instituto Superior Técnico, an MBA from Universidade Católica Portuguesa, and an Advanced Management Program (AMP) from Harvard Business School. After beginning his career in consulting, he entered the banking sector in 2000 with Santander. Since then, he has accumulated decades of experience in the industry, holding a number of senior leadership positions.

speakers.name: Dr. Laura Madrid, PhD
speakers.role: Global Intelligence Unit Research Lead at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Laura Madrid leads the research team at the Global Intelligence Unit at Global Citizen Solutions, focusing on global mobility, migration policy, and international law. She holds a PhD in Public International Law and Migration from University College London and specializes in research on global mobility, residency and citizenship, and migration trends.

speakers.name: Albert Morgenstern
speakers.role: Chief Financial Officer at Construnews · Academic Collaborator at ESADE Business School
speakers.bio: Albert Morgenstern is an academic collaborator at ESADE Business School, CFO of Construnews, and Director of the Instituto Biomecánico de Barcelona and the Morgenstern Institute, and sits on the board of WiJus-Bcn. A former international tax lawyer at PwC and Monereo Meyer Marinel·lo, he holds a Bachelor’s and Master’s in Law, a Master’s in Tax Management, and an ESADE MBA (2014). He has spent the past decade as a strategy consultant, including four years in cybersecurity, and has published in the Harvard Deusto Business Review.

speakers.name: Yanimar Hernandez
speakers.role: Legal Manager, Spain at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Yanimar Rodriguez is Head of Legal Spain at Global Citizen Solutions and a specialist in Spanish migration law, with over 10 years of experience advising individuals, families, and businesses on immigration and residency matters in Spain. She was a member of the Barcelona Bar Association from 2016 to 2022 and has been a member of the Madrid Bar Association since 2022.

speakers.name: Ruth Shaber, MD
speakers.role: Founder & President at Tara Health Foundation
speakers.bio: Ruth Shaber spent 25 years as an OBGYN and senior executive at Kaiser Permanente before turning to empowering women across finance and healthcare. She is founder and president of Tara Health Foundation and co-founder and board chair of Rhia Ventures, a collective of foundations and investors bringing new capital to reproductive health. She co-authored The XX Edge: Unlocking Higher Returns and Lower Risk, which shows that women controlling capital delivers stronger returns and lower risk. Her newest venture, the Futura Foundation, will support young Portuguese women in solving the world’s biggest challenges.

speakers.name: João Pacheco Gonçalves
speakers.role: Head of Institutional Relations at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: With an academic background in International Relations and having lived in multiple countries across three different continents, João has long been fascinated by how the world connects. His focus is bridging global mobility with private wealth strategies, helping high-net-worth individuals pair assets with alternative residencies and passports.

speakers.name: Marc Jancou
speakers.role: Founder at Marc Jancou Contemporary & Porto Arts Club
speakers.bio: Marc Jancou is an art dealer and cultural entrepreneur with over 30 years of experience working in the art world. Since opening his first gallery in 1991, Marc Jancou has supported numerous contemporary art projects and artists at various stages in their careers.

speakers.name: Luca Calabrese
speakers.role: Legal Manager, Italy at Global Citizen Solutions
speakers.bio: Luca Calabrese is an immigration lawyer and Head of Legal Italy at Global Citizen Solutions, where he leads the implementation of the full range of Italian immigration procedures, including investor visas, elective residency and citizenship, and international mobility for private clients and corporate workforces.

speakers.name: Diane Bidna
speakers.role: University & Career Counselor at TASIS Portugal
speakers.bio: Diane Bidna built the University and Career Counseling department at TASIS Portugal and guided its first graduating class through university admissions. An expert in international curricula and how universities worldwide evaluate them, she helps families choose the right school and pathway for each child. She also runs a private practice in Europe and the US, drawing on prior experience as a high school counselor and Independent Global Educational Consultant.

speakers.name: Nuno Sanches
speakers.role: Partner & Head of Operations at Cascais Ventures
speakers.bio: Nuno is a co-founder & partner at Cascais Ventures, Portugal's leading Cultural Creation Agency, specializing in the donation route of the Portuguese Residency-by-Investment program. Previously, Nuno was part of the executive team that took Kaltura, a US video technology company, public in the NASDAQ as a unicorn. Before that he created and led Vodafone Group's global TV business unit.
